notes.title: Achivements patch
notes.content:
The achievement "I choose violence" was not triggering, now it should be.
If you do not have it, even though you fulfilled the conditions, try starting a fresh run and it should trigger.

Dyslexic font was causing a few pieces of text to go out of screen bounds. We gave it a good talking to. It understands the errors of its ways.

notes.title: How to update to expanded edition for a smooth experience
notes.content:
You should be able to play the expanded edition now.
While we were putting the game out, we had a few issues related to how much content was changed. Renpy and steam don't seem to play nice together(?)

We recommend you take these steps before playing to have the best experience:

1. Completely reinstall the game:

[olist]
[*] Right click the game in your steam library > manage > browser local files > Delete "The Remainder" folder
[*] Uninstall the game from steam
[*] Install the game again
[/olist]

2. Reset any save and progress data from previous versions
In the game, go to options screen, on the bottom right, click "delete save games", and "reset progress".
The game will reset after each of these actions.

notes.title: The Remainder: Expanded Edition Kickstarter Coming Soon
notes.content:
[h3]Expanded Edition[/h3]
Greetings Weary Traveler, have a seat, sip some cactus juice, we have news to share.

The Remainder might be getting an Expanded Edition soon. 

Since making CoTTR, we've learned much and improved as writers and story-tellers, so an edit of some text will make it a better narrative experience without altering the plot. We would also like to add content that were left out of the current release due to time constraints, to make it a more complete and thoughtful experience.

This edition, if we manage to do, it would be free for everyone who already owns the game.

Some artworks will also be re-worked to achieve the same level of quality that we have for most other pieces of art, with the possibility of new scenes or character art, if we hit our funding goals.

[h3]What We Want To Do:[/h3]
[list]
[*] General text re-write and editing.
[*] A new intro scene to set the mood and lure players into the narrative.
[*] Alternative True Ending(s) for those who prefer a purely emotional connection or for those who prefer to not stay together after the ordeal is done
[*] Extra surprise endings where the story goes into other weird but characteristically Tal'Dun directions.
[*] An extended epilogue hinting at the life and challenges characters might face in a future game in the same universe.
[*] More ways to die. (Is there ever enough?)
[*] More enlightening conversations with the sage. 
[/list]

[h3]How We Want To Do it:[/h3]
In order to fulfil these goals, we will most likely run a Kickstarter campaign with a conservative goal, just enough to give us 1-2 months of time to work on these changes. We will start it sometime in July.

Naturally, we will create some interesting rewards for our backers to show our thanks. 

[list]
[*] Physical hand-written letters from the game.
[*] Art prints from scenes of the game.
[*] Limited run A3 lino block print of Ilar’s sigil.
[*] Very limited physical CD release with the game, soundtrack, and post-cards.
[*] The game itself for those who haven’t ventured into the world of Tal’Dun yet.
[/list]

If you already love CoTTR, now's the time to tell us what you'd like to see added to the expanded edition! Leave a comment below and we'll collect it to be considered for the kickstarter. 

Waters keep you,
Square Weasels

notes.title: Devlog #1 for Chronicles of Tal'Dun 2: The Hunger
notes.content:
Dear weary traveler, in case you were stuck in the Near Shallows for the last few months, CoT2 had been in development for the last few months! 

[h2]Art[/h2]
The artstyle will be a Retro-inspired side-scrolling pixel RPG look. That's a real mouthful, take a look at the screenshot: 
[img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/display/1afbe1f6-c04a-4911-943c-aa42fb33f2de_c9f06b41-c080-49b1-aef2-6b58d96c684d.png[/img]

We've developed and tested some art styles and code for the exploration mode of the game, including:
-an environment design
-sprites for characters with animation
-rendering and lighting systems

One thing I always found wanting in a retro pixel game is the lack of detail on the portraits, which is why we're going with highly detailed portraits during dialogue, like this:

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/da3f5c4f52e622b40d55ac959af57e3b/b7ec0b269ef74b0f-dc/s1280x1920/cebf1f349020185c45a4159c24d06a5779ae81a3.jpg[/img]

[h2]Characters[/h2]
There will be 6 main characters in total, and potentially more minor characters to come later. While the player will take control of Lura, every characters will be a Dyed magus who plays an indispensable role in the story. There are no pure comic-relief and side-kicks, no jar-jar binks here, even if some magi could act like clowns from time to time. After all, they are made out of meat.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
So far we have started prototyping the following:
-player movement
-dialogue system based on ink, which is used in many massively branching narrative games. 

[h2]Story[/h2]
The game will still be all about stories that will try to devour your heart, but make you whole again, and to do that we need characters who live and breath and exude humanity, so we began to write back-stories for each of the characters. 
Lura, who is a sort of magus detective specializing in magick anomalies, will be traveling to a Temple of the Deep where the Order conducts advanced research into magick. An accident had occurred there and one of the magus had disappeared without a trace. Lura will be tasked with solving this mystery while trying to come to terms with the whispers and shadows that had haunted Their own heart since They were separated from Their parents as a child. It doesn't help that in the depth of the Seas, the whispers worsened, threatening to push Lura over the edge of sanity. 

We planned to write a [i]short[i/] story for every character up to when They arrived at the temple, but the writing took on a life of its own.
For example, Evin who will be the healer has Their story already boasting 100 pages or 40k words. That's almost 1/3 of The Remainder! 

[h2]What we will do next:[/h2]
We're falling in love with our characters as their stories come to life. We also showed the stories to a few devout fans and they reported enjoying reading them very much. So our current plan is to first fully develop all the characters and find out just what sort of mysterious events and circumstances happening all over Tal'Dun had brought them all to this temple. 

Evin the healer seems to want a story of no less than 100k words to Themself. Near the shaper has Their budding story at 14k, and it just got started. We would not be surprised if by the end of this process we have a novel on our hands. A novel for the back story of a game, can you imagine?

Writing is the soul of a narrative game, so we believe it will be worth it to make writing our primary focus. We will be releasing 1 chapter of backstory that's brought to a decently polished stage to Ko-Fi and Patreon backers every 2 weeks for now, so they can get a taste of Tal'Dun while they wait. If we do our jobs right, then the stories of our other magi should be no less compelling than the story of Vyn and Ilar.

Having done this, the dialogue and scenes for the actual game will be much easier to do since now the characters will be alive in our heads and will let us know what they would say or do in each situation. 

We will also continue to develop art and designs as the writing happens, since ideas will continuously appear from the writing process. But for now art will be secondary to writing.

When the stories are ready, we may compile and edit them together into an actual novel to be given to backers or sold in our store, but that is not set in stone for now. We have our plans, but the Seas flows how it wills, doesn't it?

The overall timeline for CoT2's development is 2.5-3 years. 
We will bring an update at least once a month.

I hope to see you among our backers, or in our discord or social channels.
Take care!
-Ze

notes.title: Chronicles of Tal'Dun 2 In The Works - The Remainder Art Prints Available
notes.content:
[h1]CoT2 is in the works[/h1]
Hello there, I'm here with an update on the next game we're making!

That's right, Chronicles of Tal'Dun: The Hunger (aka CoT2) is in the works. It will have the memorable characters, emotional choices and consequences, and rich, mysterious plot of The Remainder, but rendered in a pixel RPG style. The story will take place around Lura, the Savior of Tal'Dun, some 9000 years before Vyn's time.
[h2]
Backer Pages Are Revamped[/h2]

In order to help fund the game to be develop completely independently so we can maintain our unique vision, we've revamped our Patreon and Ko-Fi pages. Now you can support us and receive exclusive updates on CoT2 and any other content in the Tal'Dun universe like stories and writing, concept art, game mockups, soundtracks, and later early alpha and beta builds.

The highest tier will grant access to a private discord channel where you can listen in or join in as we discuss and craft the characters and stories for the game, as well as read and comment on early story drafts.

You can find the pages and the details on various backer tiers and rewards here:
Ko-Fi Page[ko-fi.com]
Patreon Page[patreon.com]
The pages are mirrored, so you can pick either one.

A separate devlog will follow soon detailing the current progress on CoT2.

[h2]Art Prints Are Available[/h2]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/decb2922036d2e52ddf90aa01a48acfc/cc03e4ac0d58ae1b-e6/s2048x3072/7e00dee77181d6425e1c3d3f1a5c668875f3f952.jpg[/img]

Another way to support us and get some goodies is with the prints shop. There you can find artworks from CoTTR in A3 or Postcard sizes. Each piece is printed on 350gsm heavy matte paper and signed by the artist Nim. 

Don't forget you can join our discord by [url=https://discord.gg/dE26A9n]Clicking Here[/url] 
It's the best place to talk to us and other players, get hints and help if you're stuck, talk about headcanon and conspiracy theories, or just lurk with other people who love CoTTR.

Thanks for reading, take care, and hope to see you around!
-Ze

notes.title: Chronicles of Tal'Dun: The Remainder Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings weary travelers,

The full game is finished at last! After 20 months of development, the story of or two magi is now complete. A lot of love and tears went into crafting of this tale and Ze and I hope you will enjoy playing it it as much as we enjoyed making it.  

We are very grateful to everyone who followed and supported us in this project, hopefully the first of many!

The game ended up being much more elaborate than we originally imagined it, featuring around [b]20 hours of gameplay[/b] (depending how good are you at spotting clues. :)

We would love to hear what you think of it and if you are able to untangle  this mystery.

And if you like the game, [b]please consider writing a review[/b], these can help a lot in spreading the word about The Remainder! <3

- Ze and Nim

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1616280/Chronicles_of_TalDun_The_Remainder/
